ca_goat_rock_circuit.blurb: This is a small bouldering circuit on and around the Goat Rock formation in Castle Rock State Park. It has eight sandstone problems, running from V1 up to V8, with most of them in the V3 to V6 range. The boulders sit a few minutes on foot from the main road, so a visit is quick to set up. It pairs naturally with the neighbouring Klinghoffers boulders, and together the two give an intermediate boulderer enough to fill a day.

ca_thrutcher_dome.blurb: Thrutcher Dome is one of the granite domes of Central Wonderland in Joshua Tree National Park. It has eight routes, six on gear and two bolted, spanning 5.7 to 5.11. Lines follow sparsely bolted faces and wide cracks or chimneys, on rock of middling quality. A steep slab-and-face line of about 115 feet, well protected by nine bolts, is the standout at the top of the grade range. The walk in is the usual Wonderland approach of roughly 30 to 45 minutes, finishing across a boulder-strewn gully.

ca_tombstone_pit.blurb: Tombstone Pit is a compact, partly enclosed pocket within the Central Pinnacles, at about 7,500 feet. Its eight routes climb the faces of small pinnacles: five are bolted and three need gear. Grades run from 5.6 to 5.10d, and about half fall in the 5.10 range, so it suits climbers working on that grade more than beginners. The rock is granodiorite. To get in, follow the foot of Skyy Slab on foot, or make a short scramble up from the far end of the Claimjumper Wall, which is easier without a pack.

ca_twin_towers_2.blurb: Twin Towers is a cluster of short, dark north-facing cliffs in the Tatooine group on Fairview Mountain, in the northeast part of Apple Valley. They stand opposite the Vader roof. There are eight routes on granodiorite: five sport, two trad and one top rope, from 5.6 to 5.10 with the bulk between 5.8 and 5.10. The cliffs get little direct sun. The walk from the car takes 10 to 15 minutes along the main trail, passing around the left side of the Tatooine hill.
